## [1.1.0](https://github.com/Tomveloper/libby-patches/compare/v1.0.0...v1.1.0) (2026-10-23)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* semi fixed searchbar and keyboard operation ([4229bc3](https://github.com/Tomveloper/libby-patches/commit/4229bc3fe3636514607a44c14c209231f82c6071))

### ✨ New Features

* add multi-font library with weight editing ([e02169c](https://github.com/Tomveloper/libby-patches/commit/e02169cf259a7440ab041ec7ab343ea6764273fd))
* add reading weight selector ([843a6de](https://github.com/Tomveloper/libby-patches/commit/843a6dea15e7ad1e8974661ea72875ef35952f26))
* add searchable font library with per-font delete ([8122f07](https://github.com/Tomveloper/libby-patches/commit/8122f07a464954221b52386c5346a4c19d3b39d2))
* improve spacing and padding ([240f90c](https://github.com/Tomveloper/libby-patches/commit/240f90c86ed753f35df1a22dd004113269285ece))
* separated custom font settings, fixing some other issues ([e06b894](https://github.com/Tomveloper/libby-patches/commit/e06b894ab36a3ef0221177f8822b0d2b23b89a58))

patches.name: Custom reading font
patches.description: Renders book text with a font you upload in the reader.

patches.name: Enable WebView debugging
patches.description: Lets you inspect Libby's WebViews with chrome://inspect.

patches.name: Shared web routes
patches.description: Internal: installs one /morphe/ request router for extension patches.
